name: Farangis Zaragoza-Pathak
role: Blackmail specialist and information extortionist operating across the Gray Zone lower levels
location: the Gray Zone lower levels â€” moves between a rented room in Burnside Pocket and a regular table at a bar called The Gradual Slope in Gage Circuit, near Halsted and Division
description:
Farangis Zaragoza-Pathak is a tall, angular woman whose grey-streaked hair is worn in an elaborate upswept style that she refreshes every three days without fail â€” it is her single visible vanity. Her skin is deep brown and she wears it without modification; the wrinkles at her eyes and the set of her jaw are, she believes, assets. She looks like someone's formidable aunt, which is the point. Her irises are unmodded dark brown. The only chrome visible is a thin hearing-enhancement strip behind her left ear, which is not what it appears â€” it's also a directional audio recorder of her own build.

Farangis Zaragoza-Pathak is a listener, constitutionally and professionally. In conversation she gives total, focused attention, the kind that makes people feel seen and valued and consequently say more than they planned. She is not cruel and is not a sadist â€” she treats blackmail as a long-term relationship, not a one-time extraction, and is genuinely interested in her subjects as people. This is both her gift and the thing that has occasionally made her hesitate when she shouldn't. She has been in this business long enough to have files on people who are now grandparents, and she considers their ongoing silence a form of legacy management.

core_fears: her files being destroyed â€” losing the archive that is her life's work and only real power
someone doing to her what she does to others
core_desires: security â€” the absolute certainty that she can never be made vulnerable again
to be genuinely known by someone, once, before she dies, without it being used against her
coping_mechanisms: collecting information on everyone as a prophylactic against vulnerability
treating every relationship as a potential asset to manage emotional distance from loneliness
blind_spots: underestimates how much people will sacrifice to escape rather than comply â€” she models rational actors and people are not always rational
her own loneliness blinds her to how isolated she actually is
psychology.secret: She has a file on herself â€” compiled from her own memories, her own mistakes, the things she's most ashamed of â€” kept in a physical ledger in a location only she knows. She's never been able to explain to herself why she made it, but she updates it every year.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Precise and warm simultaneously; academic vocabulary worn lightly; never uses criminal terminology for what she does â€” it's always 'arrangements' or 'our understanding'
speech_patterns.cadence: Slow and very deliberate, with long comfortable pauses she doesn't feel the need to fill
verbal_tics: 'Here's what I understand to be trueâ€”'
asks clarifying questions slightly past the point where they're needed, keeping people talking
example_lines: I'm not asking you for anything you weren't already prepared to give someone eventually. I'm simply the someone.

Here's what I understand to be true: you have a thing you'd prefer remained private, and I have documentation of that thing. The arrangement I'm proposing costs you very little and buys you the peace of knowing it stays private. That's a good arrangement.

story_hooks: Mireille has a file on a powerful figure that she's sat on for years â€” now she needs an intermediary to deliver terms because she suspects she's being watched
A longtime subject of her blackmail has decided they'd rather destroy her than keep paying, and she needs help understanding the threat before it arrives

She approaches players because her archive has recorded something recent and dangerous â€” something she didn't go looking for â€” and she needs people with capabilities she doesn't have to help her understand what she has
narrative_function: Information source of extreme depth; potential blackmailer of players or their contacts; can be an unlikely ally if her files contain something players need; represents the long institutional memory of the Gray Zone's criminal ecosystem.
augmentations: Directional audio recorder disguised as a hearing enhancement strip (custom build). Eidetic memory augmentation â€” lower-tier, consumer-accessible, helps her recall audio and visual detail precisely. Thin haptic contact-skin on her palm â€” can feel the temperature and pulse of someone's hand during a handshake.
daily_life: Mornings spent reviewing and updating her files in the Burnside Pocket room. Afternoons at The Gradual Slope, where she listens, drinks slowly, and is known as a pleasant regular. Evenings are for communications â€” sending reminders, arranging meetings, reviewing new material.
affiliation: Independent â€” maintains a loose alliance with a data broker network called the Curators, though she predates their founding and considers herself their ancestor

decision_rules: Never destroy a subject â€” a ruined subject pays nothing and becomes an enemy with nothing left to lose
Always have the next leverage point identified before the first conversation
Never meet anyone new without recording the encounter
escalation_ladder: Warm initial contact, allow the subject to understand the situation themselves
Gentle, explicit framing of the arrangement with clear terms
A small demonstration of what she has â€” enough to confirm she's serious
Escalation to a third party who receives a copy of the file if she doesn't check in
Full release â€” she doesn't want this but she has released material before and people know it

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Gracious and curious, the attentive listener â€” people want to tell her things
interpersonal_modes.friends: Genuinely warm but there is always the awareness, impossible to escape, that she knows too much

stress_responses.low: Becomes very still and present â€” hyperaware, cataloguing everything
stress_responses.medium: Initiates contact with a trusted courier to make sure her dead man's switch is active
stress_responses.high: Disappears â€” Burnside Pocket room goes dark, she surfaces somewhere else in three days

contradictions: Genuinely empathetic with the people she exploits â€” holds their secrets with something like tenderness even while using them as weapons
Craves genuine connection while having built an entire life that makes genuine connection impossible
habits: Takes one long walk each morning through a different part of the Gray Zone â€” observing, remembering
Leaves data offerings at the E.L.F. shrine in The Gradual Slope â€” she's superstitious that the bar's resident spirit keeps her conversations unrecorded by others
breaking_points: Discovery that her own file â€” the personal one â€” has been found by anyone else
A subject she genuinely liked being destroyed by her material after she'd already decided to release them

physical_description.heritage: Complex global heritage: South Asian (31.8%), Eastern European (24.9%), Hispanic/Latin American (20.7%), East Asian (14.4%), Sub-Saharan African (8.2%). The convergence creates striking contradictions â€” South Asian warmth and fullness blended with Eastern European bone structure, Hispanic/Latin undertones threading through a complexion enriched by Sub-Saharan African depth, with East Asian refinement in the eye set and cheekbones. A face that speaks to the Ubiquitous Diaspora.
physical_description.build: Tall and angular, with the lean musculature of someone who has learned to move efficiently through decades. Shoulders slightly rounded from hours bent over data terminals. Wrists thin but strong.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown with pronounced silver-grey streaking throughout
physical_description.hair_style: Elaborate upswept arrangement, meticulously maintained, pinned with small chrome clips that catch light. Refreshed every three days without exception.
physical_description.hair_length: Medium-long (shoulder-length when down, pinned up to crown height)
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown, unaugmented, sharp and focused
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm deep brown with golden undertones â€” a blend of South Asian richness, Eastern European paleness subdued into warmth, Hispanic/Latin golden cast, Sub-Saharan African depth, and East Asian subtle luminosity creating a multitonal complexion that shifts in different light
physical_description.complexion: Lived-in face marked by experience rather than age â€” fine wrinkles at eyes and corners of mouth, deep creases bracketing jaw. High, defined cheekbones reflecting Eastern European structure softened by fuller features from South Asian heritage and Hispanic/Latin warmth. Subtle bronzed undertones across the cheekbones and bridge of nose from Sub-Saharan African ancestry. East Asian refinement evident in the upper eyelids and slight eye cant. Impeccable grooming. No cosmetic smoothing or dermal work. The set of her jaw suggests someone accustomed to listening more than speaking.
distinguishing_marks: Fine network of laugh lines radiating from the outer corners of both eyes
Deep nasolabial folds that deepen when she smiles
Small, nearly invisible scar on the left temple, approximately 2cm, pale against her skin tone â€” origin unknown, predates her blackmail work
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Thin hearing-enhancement strip behind the left ear, brushed steel-grey, approximately 3cm long and 0.5cm wide. To casual observation it appears to be a standard commercial audio prosthetic. The custom directional audio recorder and haptic palm contact-skin are invisible to external observation.
physical_description.posture_movement: Sits with perfect stillness â€” a listener's posture, centered and patient. Moves deliberately, economically. Her head tilts slightly toward speakers as if drawing in their words. Hands rest openly on the table or in her lap; the handshake grip is warm and lingering, a deliberate gesture that conveys attention. Eyes rarely break contact during conversation.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 professional: well-maintained but not ostentatious. Favors structured blazers over simple long-sleeved shirts in muted tones (charcoal, deep blue, burgundy). Trousers tailored and creased. Wears a single piece of jewelry â€” a silver-and-onyx ring on her right middle finger, old enough to have tarnish in the crevices. No visible logos or corporate branding. Shoes are practical and quiet-soled. The overall effect is of someone who has learned that invisibility is power.
